profile.title: Understanding Understanding
profile.canonical_definition: Heinz von Foerster’s collected essays on cybernetics and cognition, centring the observer, knowing, self-reference and the ethical implications of constructing descriptions.
profile.summary: Von Foerster’s essays develop a cybernetics in which observation, knowing and description cannot be treated as external to the system being discussed.
profile.why_it_matters: It provides a direct route into second-order cybernetics and the ethical consequences of taking the observer seriously.
common_misreadings: Constructed descriptions do not imply that any description is equally useful or consequence-free.
open_checks: Add essay-level links to ethics, self-reference and computation.
profile.editorial_note: Public account based on named sources; documentary provenance, interpretation and evaluative claims are kept distinct.

connections.scope_conditions: Limited to the named sources. Documentary connection, conceptual influence, teaching use and effectiveness are distinct claims.
